parameter.expression: SELECT ordemcarga AS VALUE, lpad(to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM9999'), 6, ' ') || ' - ' || roteiro AS label FROM tgford WHERE situacao = 'A' AND ordemcarga > 0 ORDER BY ordemcarga DESC

grid.title: As informações neste Dashboards é referentes aos itens das Ordens de Cargas Selecionadas
grid.expression: WITH -- 1. Ordens de carga válidas e sequência usada no PIVOT (01 a 30). ordens_carga AS (SELECT ordemcarga, row_number() over (ORDER BY ordemcarga) AS sequencia FROM (SELECT DISTINCT cab.ordemcarga FROM tgfcab cab JOIN tgfite ite ON ite.nunota = cab.nunota LEFT JOIN tgford ord ON ord.ordemcarga = cab.ordemcarga WHERE cab.tipmov = 'P' AND cab.pendente = 'S' AND ite.pendente = 'S' AND cab.ordemcarga IN :P_OC AND coalesce(ord.ad_formconc, 'N') IN :SIT AND cab.ordemcarga IS NOT NULL)), -- 2. Estoque disponível por produto, excluindo o local de estoque definido. estoque_disponivel AS (SELECT est.codprod, SUM(coalesce(est.estoque, 0)) AS estoque FROM tgfest est WHERE est.codparc = 0 AND est.codlocal <> 2030000 GROUP BY est.codprod), -- 3. Estoque reservado/definido no local específico. estoque_definido AS (SELECT est.codprod, SUM(coalesce(est.estoque, 0)) AS estoque_def FROM tgfest est WHERE est.codparc = 0 AND est.codlocal = 2030000 GROUP BY est.codprod), -- 4. Estoque dos produtos SA no local 2010000. estoque_produtos_sa AS (SELECT est.codprod, SUM(est.estoque) AS estoque_sa FROM tgfest est WHERE est.codlocal = 2010000 GROUP BY est.codprod), /* 5. Relacionamento do produto acabado com os produtos SA. A regra do grupo 301 foi preservada: - Quando o primeiro produto SA pertence ao grupo 301, ele passa a ocupar a posição SA principal e a segunda posição fica nula. - Nos demais casos, são mantidas as duas posições originais.*/ produtos_sa_base AS (SELECT pro.codprod, pro.ad_cod_prod_sa AS cod_sa_1, sa1.descrprod || sa1.compldesc AS descricao_sa_1, substr(sa1.codgrupoprod, 1, 3) AS grupo_sa_1, pro_sa.ad_cod_prod_sa AS cod_sa_2, sa2.descrprod || sa2.compldesc AS descricao_sa_2, substr(sa2.codgrupoprod, 1, 3) AS grupo_sa_2 FROM tgfpro pro LEFT JOIN tgfpro pro_sa ON pro_sa.codprod = pro.ad_cod_prod_sa LEFT JOIN tgfpro sa1 ON sa1.codprod = pro.ad_cod_prod_sa LEFT JOIN tgfpro sa2 ON sa2.codprod = pro_sa.ad_cod_prod_sa WHERE substr(pro.codgrupoprod, 1, 1) = '4'), produtos_sa_normalizados AS (SELECT codprod, CASE WHEN grupo_sa_1 = '301' THEN NULL ELSE cod_sa_1 END AS codpro_pint, CASE WHEN grupo_sa_1 = '301' THEN NULL ELSE descricao_sa_1 END AS descricao_pint, CASE WHEN grupo_sa_1 = '301' THEN descricao_sa_1 ELSE descricao_sa_2 END AS descricao_sa, CASE WHEN grupo_sa_1 = '301' THEN cod_sa_1 ELSE cod_sa_2 END AS codpro_sa FROM produtos_sa_base), produtos_sa AS (SELECT ps.codprod, ps.codpro_sa, coalesce(es_sa.estoque_sa, 0) AS estsa, ps.codpro_pint, es_pint.estoque_sa AS estpint FROM produtos_sa_normalizados ps LEFT JOIN estoque_produtos_sa es_sa ON es_sa.codprod = ps.codpro_sa LEFT JOIN estoque_produtos_sa es_pint ON es_pint.codprod = ps.codpro_pint -- Expressão original preservada, embora pareça redundante. WHERE (ps.codpro_sa + ps.codpro_sa) IS NOT NULL), -- 6. Itens pendentes das ordens de carga, com quantidade e valores calculados. itens_ordem_carga AS (SELECT ite.codprod, prod_sa.codpro_sa, prod_sa.estsa, prod_sa.codpro_pint, prod_sa.estpint, (ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) AS qtd_pendente, ordem.sequencia, cab.ordemcarga, ite.ad_vlrunitfrete * (ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) AS valor_frete, pro.m3 * (ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) AS volume_m3 FROM tgfcab cab JOIN tgfite ite ON ite.nunota = cab.nunota JOIN tgfpro pro ON pro.codprod = ite.codprod JOIN ordens_carga ordem ON ordem.ordemcarga = cab.ordemcarga LEFT JOIN produtos_sa prod_sa ON prod_sa.codprod = ite.codprod WHERE cab.tipmov = 'P' AND ite.pendente = 'S' AND cab.pendente = 'S'), -- 7. Consolidação por produto e posição da ordem de carga. PIVOT mantém as 30 posições fixas esperadas pelo relatório. ordens_por_produto AS (SELECT codprod, codpro_sa, estsa, codpro_pint, estpint, "A01_OCA" AS oca_01, "A01_QTD" AS qtd_01, "A01_FRT" AS frt_01, "A01_MT3" AS mt3_01, "A02_OCA" AS oca_02, "A02_QTD" AS qtd_02, "A02_FRT" AS frt_02, "A02_MT3" AS mt3_02, "A03_OCA" AS oca_03, "A03_QTD" AS qtd_03, "A03_FRT" AS frt_03, "A03_MT3" AS mt3_03, "A04_OCA" AS oca_04, "A04_QTD" AS qtd_04, "A04_FRT" AS frt_04, "A04_MT3" AS mt3_04, "A05_OCA" AS oca_05, "A05_QTD" AS qtd_05, "A05_FRT" AS frt_05, "A05_MT3" AS mt3_05, "A06_OCA" AS oca_06, "A06_QTD" AS qtd_06, "A06_FRT" AS frt_06, "A06_MT3" AS mt3_06, "A07_OCA" AS oca_07, "A07_QTD" AS qtd_07, "A07_FRT" AS frt_07, "A07_MT3" AS mt3_07, "A08_OCA" AS oca_08, "A08_QTD" AS qtd_08, "A08_FRT" AS frt_08, "A08_MT3" AS mt3_08, "A09_OCA" AS oca_09, "A09_QTD" AS qtd_09, "A09_FRT" AS frt_09, "A09_MT3" AS mt3_09, "A10_OCA" AS oca_10, "A10_QTD" AS qtd_10, "A10_FRT" AS frt_10, "A10_MT3" AS mt3_10, "A11_OCA" AS oca_11, "A11_QTD" AS qtd_11, "A11_FRT" AS frt_11, "A11_MT3" AS mt3_11, "A12_OCA" AS oca_12, "A12_QTD" AS qtd_12, "A12_FRT" AS frt_12, "A12_MT3" AS mt3_12, "A13_OCA" AS oca_13, "A13_QTD" AS qtd_13, "A13_FRT" AS frt_13, "A13_MT3" AS mt3_13, "A14_OCA" AS oca_14, "A14_QTD" AS qtd_14, "A14_FRT" AS frt_14, "A14_MT3" AS mt3_14, "A15_OCA" AS oca_15, "A15_QTD" AS qtd_15, "A15_FRT" AS frt_15, "A15_MT3" AS mt3_15, "A16_OCA" AS oca_16, "A16_QTD" AS qtd_16, "A16_FRT" AS frt_16, "A16_MT3" AS mt3_16, "A17_OCA" AS oca_17, "A17_QTD" AS qtd_17, "A17_FRT" AS frt_17, "A17_MT3" AS mt3_17, "A18_OCA" AS oca_18, "A18_QTD" AS qtd_18, "A18_FRT" AS frt_18, "A18_MT3" AS mt3_18, "A19_OCA" AS oca_19, "A19_QTD" AS qtd_19, "A19_FRT" AS frt_19, "A19_MT3" AS mt3_19, "A20_OCA" AS oca_20, "A20_QTD" AS qtd_20, "A20_FRT" AS frt_20, "A20_MT3" AS mt3_20, "A21_OCA" AS oca_21, "A21_QTD" AS qtd_21, "A21_FRT" AS frt_21, "A21_MT3" AS mt3_21, "A22_OCA" AS oca_22, "A22_QTD" AS qtd_22, "A22_FRT" AS frt_22, "A22_MT3" AS mt3_22, "A23_OCA" AS oca_23, "A23_QTD" AS qtd_23, "A23_FRT" AS frt_23, "A23_MT3" AS mt3_23, "A24_OCA" AS oca_24, "A24_QTD" AS qtd_24, "A24_FRT" AS frt_24, "A24_MT3" AS mt3_24, "A25_OCA" AS oca_25, "A25_QTD" AS qtd_25, "A25_FRT" AS frt_25, "A25_MT3" AS mt3_25, "A26_OCA" AS oca_26, "A26_QTD" AS qtd_26, "A26_FRT" AS frt_26, "A26_MT3" AS mt3_26, "A27_OCA" AS oca_27, "A27_QTD" AS qtd_27, "A27_FRT" AS frt_27, "A27_MT3" AS mt3_27, "A28_OCA" AS oca_28, "A28_QTD" AS qtd_28, "A28_FRT" AS frt_28, "A28_MT3" AS mt3_28, "A29_OCA" AS oca_29, "A29_QTD" AS qtd_29, "A29_FRT" AS frt_29, "A29_MT3" AS mt3_29, "A30_OCA" AS oca_30, "A30_QTD" AS qtd_30, "A30_FRT" AS frt_30, "A30_MT3" AS mt3_30 FROM (SELECT codprod, codpro_sa, estsa, codpro_pint, estpint, sequencia, ordemcarga, qtd_pendente, valor_frete, volume_m3 FROM itens_ordem_carga) pivot(MAX(ordemcarga) AS oca, SUM(qtd_pendente) AS qtd, SUM(valor_frete) AS frt, SUM(volume_m3) AS mt3 FOR sequencia IN(01 AS a01, 02 AS a02, 03 AS a03, 04 AS a04, 05 AS a05, 06 AS a06, 07 AS a07, 08 AS a08, 09 AS a09, 10 AS a10, 11 AS a11, 12 AS a12, 13 AS a13, 14 AS a14, 15 AS a15, 16 AS a16, 17 AS a17, 18 AS a18, 19 AS a19, 20 AS a20, 21 AS a21, 22 AS a22, 23 AS a23, 24 AS a24, 25 AS a25, 26 AS a26, 27 AS a27, 28 AS a28, 29 AS a29, 30 AS a30))), -- 8. Quantidade de pedidos com observação por ordem de carga e produto. pedidos_com_observacao_qtd AS (SELECT cab.ordemcarga, ite.codprod, COUNT(DISTINCT ite.nunota) AS qtdpedobs FROM tgfite ite JOIN tgfcab cab ON cab.nunota = ite.nunota WHERE ite.observacao IS NOT NULL AND cab.ordemcarga IN :P_OC GROUP BY cab.ordemcarga, ite.codprod), -- 9. Numeração dos pedidos com observação: ROW_NUMBER substitui RANK porque a origem já elimina duplicidades por ordem de carga, produto e nota; assim cada nota recebe uma posição única. pedidos_com_observacao_num AS (SELECT cab.ordemcarga, ite.codprod, ite.nunota, row_number() over (PARTITION BY cab.ordemcarga, ite.codprod ORDER BY ite.nunota) AS sequencia FROM tgfite ite JOIN tgfcab cab ON cab.nunota = ite.nunota WHERE ite.observacao IS NOT NULL AND cab.ordemcarga > 0 AND cab.ordemcarga IN :P_OC GROUP BY cab.ordemcarga, ite.codprod, ite.nunota), -- 10. Até 20 números de pedido por ordem de carga e produto. pedidos_com_observacao_pivot AS (SELECT ordemcarga, codprod, p01_nunota, p02_nunota, p03_nunota, p04_nunota, p05_nunota, p06_nunota, p07_nunota, p08_nunota, p09_nunota, p10_nunota, p11_nunota, p12_nunota, p13_nunota, p14_nunota, p15_nunota, p16_nunota, p17_nunota, p18_nunota, p19_nunota, p20_nunota FROM pedidos_com_observacao_num pivot(MAX(nunota) FOR sequencia IN(1 AS p01_nunota, 2 AS p02_nunota, 3 AS p03_nunota, 4 AS p04_nunota, 5 AS p05_nunota, 6 AS p06_nunota, 7 AS p07_nunota, 8 AS p08_nunota, 9 AS p09_nunota, 10 AS p10_nunota, 11 AS p11_nunota, 12 AS p12_nunota, 13 AS p13_nunota, 14 AS p14_nunota, 15 AS p15_nunota, 16 AS p16_nunota, 17 AS p17_nunota, 18 AS p18_nunota, 19 AS p19_nunota, 20 AS p20_nunota))), /* 11. Formatação textual da lista de pedidos observados. */ pedidos_com_observacao_texto AS (SELECT ordemcarga, codprod, CASE WHEN p01_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN 'OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p01_nunota END || CASE WHEN p02_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p02_nunota END || CASE WHEN p03_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p03_nunota END || CASE WHEN p04_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p04_nunota END || CASE WHEN p05_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p05_nunota END || CASE WHEN p06_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p06_nunota END || CASE WHEN p07_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p07_nunota END || CASE WHEN p08_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p08_nunota END || CASE WHEN p09_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p09_nunota END || CASE WHEN p10_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p10_nunota END || CASE WHEN p11_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p11_nunota END || CASE WHEN p12_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p12_nunota END || CASE WHEN p13_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p13_nunota END || CASE WHEN p14_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p14_nunota END || CASE WHEN p15_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p15_nunota END || CASE WHEN p16_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p16_nunota END || CASE WHEN p17_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p17_nunota END || CASE WHEN p18_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p18_nunota END || CASE WHEN p19_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p19_nunota END || CASE WHEN p20_nunota IS NOT NULL THEN ', OC: ' || to_char(ordemcarga, 'FM999999') || ' Ped: ' || p20_nunota END AS pedcomobs FROM pedidos_com_observacao_pivot), -- 12. Base agregada do relatório: Estoques são consultados uma única vez por produto, em vez de executar subqueries correlacionadas repetidamente para cada linha/expressão. resumo_produto AS (SELECT to_char(lpad(gru.codgrupoprod, 10, 0), 'FM00G00G00G000') AS codgrupoprod, gru.descrgrupoprod, ite.codprod, pro.descrprod, obs_qtd.qtdpedobs, obs_txt.pedcomobs, pro.marca, oc.codpro_sa, oc.estsa, oc.codpro_pint, oc.estpint, SUM(ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) AS pendente, coalesce(est.estoque, 0) AS estoque, coalesce(est_def.estoque_def, 0) AS estoque_def, coalesce(est.estoque, 0) - coalesce(SUM(ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida), 0) AS dif, CASE WHEN coalesce(est.estoque, 0) - coalesce(SUM(ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida), 0) > 0 THEN 'Sobrando' ELSE 'Faltando' END AS situacao, SUM((ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) * (ite.ad_vlrliq / ite.qtdneg)) AS vlttot, SUM((ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) * ite.ad_vlrunitfrete) AS frete, coalesce(pro.estmin, 0) AS estmin, CASE WHEN coalesce(est.estoque, 0) - coalesce(SUM(ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida), 0) <= 0 THEN 'RED' WHEN coalesce(est.estoque, 0) - coalesce(SUM(ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida), 0) <= pro.estmin THEN 'YELLOW' ELSE 'BLUE' END AS farol, oc.oca_01 AS oca_01, oc.qtd_01 AS qtd_01, oc.frt_01 AS frt_01, oc.mt3_01 AS mt3_01, oc.oca_02 AS oca_02, oc.qtd_02 AS qtd_02, oc.frt_02 AS frt_02, oc.mt3_02 AS mt3_02, oc.oca_03 AS oca_03, oc.qtd_03 AS qtd_03, oc.frt_03 AS frt_03, oc.mt3_03 AS mt3_03, oc.oca_04 AS oca_04, oc.qtd_04 AS qtd_04, oc.frt_04 AS frt_04, oc.mt3_04 AS mt3_04, oc.oca_05 AS oca_05, oc.qtd_05 AS qtd_05, oc.frt_05 AS frt_05, oc.mt3_05 AS mt3_05, oc.oca_06 AS oca_06, AS frt_08, oc.mt3_08 AS mt3_08, oc.oca_09 AS oca_09, oc.qtd_09 AS qtd_09, oc.frt_09 AS frt_09, oc.mt3_09 AS mt3_09, oc.oca_10 AS oca_10, oc.qtd_10 AS qtd_10, oc.frt_10 AS frt_10, oc.mt3_10 AS mt3_10, oc.oca_11 AS oca_11, oc.qtd_11 AS qtd_11, oc.frt_11 AS frt_11, oc.mt3_11 AS mt3_11, oc.oca_12 AS oca_12, oc.qtd_12 AS qtd_12, oc.frt_12 AS frt_12, oc.mt3_12 AS mt3_12, oc.oca_13 AS oca_13, oc.qtd_13 AS qtd_13, oc.frt_13 AS frt_13, oc.mt3_13 AS mt3_13, oc.oca_14 AS oca_14, oc.qtd_14 AS qtd_14, oc.frt_14 AS frt_14, oc.mt3_14 AS mt3_14, oc.oca_15 AS oca_15, oc.qtd_15 AS qtd_15, oc.frt_15 AS frt_15, gru ON gru.codgrupoprod = pro.codgrupoprod LEFT JOIN tgford ord ON ord.ordemcarga = cab.ordemcarga LEFT JOIN pedidos_com_observacao_qtd obs_qtd ON obs_qtd.codprod = ite.codprod LEFT JOIN grid.title: Parceiro
grid.expression: WITH top_operacoes AS (SELECT DISTINCT top.codtipoper, top.dhalter, top.descroper FROM tgftop top), tabelas_precos AS (SELECT DISTINCT tab.nutab, nta.nometab AS destabprc FROM tgftab tab INNER JOIN tgfnta nta ON nta.codtab = tab.codtab), itens_pendentes AS (SELECT cab.nunota, cab.codtipoper, cab.dhtipoper, cab.dtneg, cab.codparc, cab.ordemcarga, ite.nutab, ite.codprod, ite.qtdneg, ite.qtdentregue, ite.qtdconferida, ite.ad_vlrliq, ite.ad_vlrunitfrete, pro.m3, par.razaosocial, cid.nomecid, uf.uf, ord.ad_formconc, -- Quantidade efetivamente pendente do item (ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) AS qtdpendente FROM tgfcab cab INNER JOIN tgfite ite ON ite.nunota = cab.nunota INNER JOIN tgfpro pro ON pro.codprod = ite.codprod INNER JOIN tgfpar par ON par.codparc = cab.codparc INNER JOIN tsicid cid ON cid.codcid = par.codcid INNER JOIN tsiufs uf ON uf.coduf = cid.uf LEFT JOIN tgford ord ON ord.ordemcarga = cab.ordemcarga WHERE cab.tipmov = 'P' AND cab.pendente = 'S' -- Filtro de ordens de carga: permite seleção múltipla AND cab.ordemcarga IN :P_OC -- Filtro de situação da ordem de carga AND nvl(ord.ad_formconc, 'N') IN :SIT), dados_calculados AS (SELECT ip.nunota, ip.codtipoper, top.descroper AS desctop, ip.dtneg, ip.codparc, ip.razaosocial, ip.nutab, tab.destabprc, -- Cidade e UF do parceiro ip.nomecid || '-' || ip.uf AS cidadeuf, -- Volume pendente em metros cúbicos (ip.m3 * ip.qtdpendente) AS totalm3, -- Valor líquido proporcional à quantidade pendente (ip.ad_vlrliq / ip.qtdneg) * ip.qtdpendente AS vlritem, -- Valor do frete proporcional à quantidade pendente (ip.qtdpendente * ip.ad_vlrunitfrete) AS vlrfrete FROM itens_pendentes ip LEFT JOIN top_operacoes top ON top.codtipoper = ip.codtipoper AND top.dhalter = ip.dhtipoper LEFT JOIN tabelas_precos tab ON tab.nutab = ip.nutab) SELECT dc.codtipoper, dc.desctop, dc.nunota, dc.dtneg, dc.codparc, dc.razaosocial, dc.nutab, dc.destabprc, dc.cidadeuf, -- Volume total pendente SUM(dc.totalm3) AS totalm3, -- Valor total dos itens pendentes SUM(dc.vlritem) AS vlrnota, -- Valor total do frete pendente SUM(dc.vlrfrete) AS vlrfrete FROM dados_calculados dc GROUP BY dc.codtipoper, dc.desctop, dc.nunota, dc.dtneg, dc.codparc, dc.razaosocial, dc.nutab, dc.destabprc, dc.cidadeuf ORDER BY dc.nunota, dc.dtneg

grid.title: Por Pedido
grid.expression: WITH itens_filtrados AS (SELECT cab.nunota, ite.codprod, pro.descrprod, pro.m3, ite.qtdneg, ite.qtdentregue, ite.qtdconferida, ite.ad_vlrliq, ite.ad_vlrunitfrete, (ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) AS qtdpendente FROM tgfcab cab INNER JOIN tgfite ite ON ite.nunota = cab.nunota INNER JOIN tgfpro pro ON pro.codprod = ite.codprod WHERE cab.tipmov = 'P' AND cab.pendente = 'S' AND ite.pendente = 'S' AND cab.nunota = :A_NUNOTA), itens_calculados AS (SELECT nunota, codprod, descrprod, (m3 * qtdpendente) AS m3, qtdpendente AS qtdneg, qtdpendente * (ad_vlrliq / qtdneg) AS vlrtot, qtdpendente * ad_vlrunitfrete AS vlrfrete FROM itens_filtrados) SELECT nunota, codprod, descrprod, m3, qtdneg, vlrtot, vlrfrete FROM itens_calculados ORDER BY codprod

grid.title: Por Item
grid.expression: WITH itens_filtrados AS (SELECT cab.codparc, par.razaosocial, cid.nomecid, uf.uf, cab.dtneg, cab.nunota, ite.codprod, pro.descrprod, pro.m3, ite.qtdneg, ite.ad_vlrliq, ite.ad_vlrunitfrete, (ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) AS qtdpendente FROM tgfcab cab INNER JOIN tgfpar par ON par.codparc = cab.codparc INNER JOIN tgfite ite ON ite.nunota = cab.nunota INNER JOIN tgfpro pro ON pro.codprod = ite.codprod INNER JOIN tsicid cid ON cid.codcid = par.codcid INNER JOIN tsiufs uf ON uf.coduf = cid.uf LEFT JOIN tgford ord ON ord.ordemcarga = cab.ordemcarga WHERE cab.tipmov = 'P' AND ite.pendente = 'S' AND cab.ordemcarga IN :P_OC AND ite.codprod IN :A_CODPROD AND nvl(ord.ad_formconc, 'N') IN :SIT), itens_calculados AS (SELECT codparc, razaosocial, nomecid, uf, dtneg, nunota, codprod, descrprod, qtdpendente AS pendente, qtdpendente * m3 AS m3, qtdpendente * (ad_vlrliq / qtdneg) AS valor, qtdpendente * ad_vlrunitfrete AS frete FROM itens_filtrados) SELECT codparc, razaosocial, nomecid, uf, dtneg, nunota, codprod, descrprod, pendente, m3, valor, frete FROM itens_calculados ORDER BY nunota
